organism.model_system_note: Madin-Darby canine kidney (MDCK) epithelium is the canine cell system attached to this catalog entry. Coat-color genetics of the domestic dog (Canis lupus familiaris) are a separate, coarser phenotype.

evolutionary_history.what_changes_at_this_scale: Relative to a Murray (1981) mammalian coat pre-pattern of order 2 cm, this detail-scale (s0) slot selects lambda_c = 1.781 um, so k_c is larger by a factor of about 1.1e4. The domain that supports a small integer number of modes shrinks from the flank to one MDCK apical face (14.248 um = 8 wavelengths). k_c is set by diffusivities and the reaction rate; chronospecies would change the mode count only by changing domain length L. This Canis series contains only the Holocene extant stage, so there is no predecessor chronospecies to subtract.

scale.label: 1.8 µm
scale.quantity: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength, instantiated here as the subcellular Schnakenberg wavelength on an MDCK apical cortex

pde: du/dt = D_u * laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 * v)
dv/dt = D_v * laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 * v)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k) = tr(J_k)/2 + sqrt((tr/2)^2 - det(J_k)), J_k = J - k^2 diag(D_u, D_v)

boundary_conditions.domain: periodic square patch, side L = 8 * lambda_c = 14.248 um
boundary_conditions.justification: Turing (1952) used a periodic ring. A periodic patch is the local tangent-plane sample of an MDCK apical cortex, not a claim that the cyst is a torus.

parameters.note: Dimensionless D and gamma are a unique (a, b, ratio, gamma) tuple for slot 3139, scaled so the determinant formula for k_c lands on 1.781 um when one dimensionless length is L0 = lambda_c * k_c / (2*pi) metres and the time unit is 1 s. They are not copied from a sibling slot.

empirical_claims.claim: A two-species reaction-diffusion system can be unstable to a finite band of wavenumbers while the homogeneous state remains stable.
empirical_claims.source: Turing 1952, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B 237:37-72

empirical_claims.claim: The Schnakenberg trimolecular reactions produce a stable limit cycle in a well-mixed reactor and, with diffusion, a Turing instability when the inhibitor diffuses sufficiently faster than the activator.
Mammalian coat markings can be read as a Turing pre-pattern whose wavelength is set on the embryonic flank, at centimetre scale, not at 1.8 um.
MDCK cells, a canine kidney line, build a polarized cyst whose apical cortex is a few cell-diameters across; PTEN/Cdc42 segregate apical phosphoinositides.
empirical_claims.source: Martin-Belmonte et al. 2007, Cell 128:383-397; Bryant and Mostov 2008, Nat. Rev. Mol. Cell Biol. 9:887-901

empirical_claims.claim: Black coat color in domestic dogs is caused by a beta-defensin mutation at CBD103, a genetic switch, not a measured 1.781 um Turing wavelength.
